sloka: यस्मिंश्च कारणे वायुश्चुक्रोध च रुरोध च ।प्रजाः शृणुध्वं तत्सर्वं श्रोतव्यं चात्मनः क्षमम् ।। ७.३५.५८ ॥
transliteration: yasmiṁśca kāraṇe vāyuścukrodha ca rurodha ca ।prajāḥ śṛṇudhvaṁ tatsarvaṁ śrotavyaṁ cātmanaḥ kṣamam ।। 7.35.58 ॥

translations.english: Prajapati then instructed the people to listen to the entire beneficial reason for which Vayu became angry and caused obstruction.
